[IDSP.14.3] **Field order is load-bearing.**  The table
has eight slots, 0–7, and their order must match RAOT.6 exactly; slot 7 is a
formatting service, not an action verb ([IDSP.14.2]).  Any change to
field order or count is a breaking change requiring a
minor release ([LDET.1.10]) and recompilation of all `CompiledCode`
atom blobs.
